quality_check.description: A single vertical atlas-card scene shows numerous white swans moving through a stylized pale shoreline and winding blue-gray waterway, with one unmistakable soot-black swan acting as the anomalous observation. Thin abstract arcs, trajectories, nested curves, and ordered linework cross the landscape and visibly break or destabilize around the black swan, where sparse vermilion rupture marks concentrate. The palette is dominated by bone white, pale stone, soot black, muted storm blue-gray, and restrained teal vegetation. The rendering has dry screen-printed contours, coarse archival grain, slight registration character, and worn edges. The composition is enclosed by a thick imperfect dark outer print edge, narrow pale margin, and inset illustration window with distressed corners. Vegetation and distant landforms suggest a simplified natural shoreline. The scene continues through the full lower area with rocks, reeds, water, and swans rather than reserving a caption panel. No people, readable text, labels, numbers, UI, swatches, grid layout, or character turnaround are visible.

prompt:
Create one standalone 9:16 WORLD_KEYFRAME, completely host-free, establishing Taleb’s Black Swan concept as an inside-book subject world. Use a fractured probability screen-print aesthetic: dry matte ink, coarse archival print grain, slight registration wear, crisp flat contours with occasional broken-ink edges. Palette: bone white and pale stone, dense soot black, muted storm blue-gray, restrained oxidized teal, with sparse vermilion only at ruptures and anomalies. Lighting is graphic and high-contrast, built from broad matte light fields and deep ink shadows.

Compose a symbolic natural-history scene: several white swans move through a stylized pale shoreline landscape while one unmistakable black swan appears as the disruptive observation. Surround the environment with restrained, thin technical geometry—probability arcs, forecast trajectories, nested model shapes, and ordered lines—that remain abstract and label-free; these structures visibly fracture, diverge, or terminate around the black swan, with a few vermilion break marks emphasizing failed assumptions. Suggest distant Australian shoreline character through simplified vegetation and landforms without signage or literal labels. Atmosphere: calm certainty suddenly destabilized by one undeniable exception; cerebral, archival, precise, ominously elegant.

Place everything inside the recurring vertical screen-printed atlas-card frame: thick imperfect soot-black outer print edge, narrow bone-white breathing margin, inset rectangular illustration window, tiny registration offsets, worn ink corners. Use the full illustration height naturally; no caption reserve, blank strip, empty lower panel, or low-detail band.

Absolutely no people, recurring host, selected host, foreground character, readable text, letters, numbers, UI, charts, grid, sheet layout, swatches, photorealism, glossy CGI, anime, watercolor, sepia engraving, or neon cyberpunk. If a reference image is supplied, use it only as the medium/style anchor, never as composition. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: every image appears inside the same vertically oriented screen-printed atlas card: a thick imperfect soot-black outer print edge, narrow bone-white breathing margin, and a slightly inset rectangular illustration window with tiny registration offsets and worn ink corners. Diagrams, environments, swans, tools, markets, and technology scenes all remain inside this repeated print-window grammar, with the border thickness and inner margins held consistent throughout the episode. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI. Binding isolation: no recurring host, no selected host, and no foreground person or character.
